items.source: Execute the supplied ExceptionCollector.Executable and track any exception thrown.
items.translation: 执行提供的ExceptionCollector.Executable并跟踪任何抛出的异常。

items.source: Get the list of exceptions encountered in execute(Executable).
items.translation: 获取在execute(Executable)中遇到的异常列表。

items.source: If this collector contains a single Throwable, this method throws an AssertionError with the error message of the Throwable and with the Throwable as the cause.
items.translation: 如果此收集器包含单个 `Throwable`，则此方法会抛出一个带有该 `Throwable` 的错误消息以及以该 `Throwable` 为原因（`cause`）的 `AssertionError`。

items.source: If this collector contains multiple exceptions, this method throws an AssertionError whose message is "Multiple Exceptions (#):" followed by a new line with the error message of each exception separated by a new line, with # replaced with the number of exceptions present. In addition, each exception will be added to the AssertionError as a suppressed exception.
items.translation: 如果此收集器包含多个异常，则此方法会抛出一个 `AssertionError`，其消息为 "Multiple Exceptions (#):"，后跟一行，其中每个异常的错误消息由换行符分隔，并将 `#` 替换为存在的异常数量。此外，每个异常都将作为 抑制的异常 添加到 `AssertionError` 中。

items.source: If this collector contains a single Error or Exception, this method rethrows the error or exception.
items.translation: 如果此收集器包含单个 Error 或 Exception， 此方法将重新抛出该错误或异常。

items.source: This utility is intended to support soft assertion use cases similar to the SoftAssertions support in AssertJ and the assertAll() support in JUnit Jupiter.
items.translation: 此工具旨在支持类似于 AssertJ 中的 `SoftAssertions` 支持和 JUnit Jupiter 中的 `assertAll()` 支持的软断言soft assertion用例。

items.source: If this collector is empty, this method is effectively a no-op.
items.translation: 如果该收集器为空，此方法实际上是一个空操作。

items.source: Assert that this ExceptionCollector does not contain any exceptions.
items.translation: 断言此ExceptionCollector不包含任何异常。

items.source: an unmodifiable copy of the list of exceptions, potentially empty
items.translation: 一个可能为空的异常列表的不可变副本

items.source: Executable is a functional interface that can be used to implement any generic block of code that potentially throws a Throwable.
items.translation: Executable 是一个功能接口，可用于实现任何可能抛出 Throwable 的通用代码块。
